reviewScope.classification: Engineering finite exact-step benchmarking only; no attack advancement, exponent, cryptanalytic ratio, private-key recovery or new scientific boundary claim.

codeReview.guards: Environment strictly accepts0/1; shared1 requires WP2 and walk-network bit1. Existing WP2 parents are validated upstream. C++ defaults/guards and runtime marker remain consistent.
codeReview.imageAndCache: Shared selection appears in image environment, baked build command, BAKED identity, buildFor requested identity/rebuild command and runBench no-rebuild comparison. The new test first proves a matching untouched bake succeeds, then toggles only shared mode and requires rejection before another measurement.
codeReview.ranking: All packed benchmark and collection sample gates parse one observed0/1 marker, store actual and expected separately, invalidate missing/duplicate/wrong values and zero invalid rates. Non-packed paths retain None.
codeReview.profile: Successful packed profile results require one matching observed shared marker. Unavailable profiler results preserve the original failure kind instead of being relabeled as identity failures.
codeReview.probeOrder: Applicable WP2 walk-network audits run arithmetic, optional tiled storage, shared probe, integration, then timing. Probe uses exactly the same make flags and is phony; nonzero exit or any wrong/missing/duplicate marker/PASS inventory aborts before integration/timing.
codeReview.storage: Existing tiled storage gate retains128 cases and18584*B records with B1..64 validation before build; untiled audits retain their existing batch compatibility.
codeReview.legacy: WP0/WP1 skip the inapplicable shared probe and keep existing arithmetic/client paths. Untiled WP2 still runs the shared probe. Shared0 remains the general default.
codeReview.preset: RTX shared default1 and explicit override0 flow through both Make targets; compact override remains independent. Preset B16/T256/min2/workers385024 and exact count contract are unchanged.
codeReview.resources: Only a host diagnostic for the current device reserved shared bytes was added. Core measured source matches, and generic ranking does not hardcode1792/2816 resource accounting.

docsReview: SHARED-SIGMA, README and RTX-PRO6000 separate matched finite gains from prior public absolute rates, disclose the narrow screen qualification/drift and runtime-versus-compiled shared accounting, call the work engineering, state the public audit is pending and keep26B unmet.

independentActions: Read changed source/test/doc bodies and relevant current call paths.
Parsed four changed Python files for syntax.
Rehashed transfer/archive/core source and checked git diff scope/whitespace.
Recomputed documented raw row statistics/counts/calibration bindings.
tests.testExecutionClaim: Producer passing tests are retained handoff evidence; this reviewer did not rerun those suites.

limits: Approval is scoped to these file hashes and integration behavior, not a new public GPU audit.
The retained full native-code/correctness panel is hash-bound; its complete independent GPU auditor was not rerun by this review.
The standalone shared-table probe uses256-thread test blocks; it does not independently certify every possible client block width. Actual integration runs the selected client geometry.
Generic public audit retains corpus counts/bytes; the matched frozen comparison supplies sorted-multiset hashes. No public corpus-content hash is invented.
No universal speedup, performance-counter causality, exponent improvement or achieved26B goal is claimed.
publicCommandGpuAudit: Pending at this review; root owns the first public Make audit.

reviewerCorrection.reason: Initial offline assertion compared mutable temperature/clock telemetry. Successor checks stable GPU name, UUID and driver identity; original raw artifact is unchanged.
